description: 60 original bilingual first-pass drafts (15 each A2/B1/B2/C1); no independent linguistic review or audio.

stages.stage_1_english: Original English definition and POS; editorial draft only
stages.stage_2_myanmar: Original Burmese sense-matched meaning; editorial draft only
stages.stage_3_example: Original illustrative sentence; grammar and sense unverified
stages.stage_4_evidence: Separate independent source-evidence tasks; no source pages visited
stages.stage_5_audio: No new George/Emma recordings or listening checks
